description: Image Description: The image features a collection of ski poles and skis leaning against a colorful, textured wall. The wall has an artistic design with a green background, white polka dots, and abstract shapes in red, blue, and orange. The skis and poles are arranged vertically, with their tips pointing upward. The equipment varies in color and design, indicating different brands and styles. The scene suggests an outdoor setting, possibly near a ski resort or rental shop.
